blocks.x: A working build of IoT, Twin & Robotics for Renewable Energy: the operating context that shapes it, the services sequenced through the method, and the deltas we commit to.

Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization. Margins live in availability percentage points and forecast accuracy — both telemetry problems.

items: Turbines/inverters fail unscheduled; availability points lost.
Generation forecasts feed trading poorly; imbalance costs.

Governance inherits the sector frame — Grid codes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Sense everything that matters: retrofit-friendly sensor network with governed telemetry.
Simulate before you cut steel: plant, fleet and product twins with governed physics and data.
Cameras into instruments: inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.

At Energy & Utilities level this capability reads as: behind-the-meter device orchestration with customer consent (flexibility revenue unlocked). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
